findings.description: Directly inspected all five regenerated V110 views and six poses. The traced shared collar/back seam vertex 205 now remains unchanged through collar and torso contour passes, but a distinct severe posterior neck/shoulder facet remains (internal discontinuity 178.52 degrees on a 4.78 mm edge near Blender Z 1.055 m). The local transform correction did not visibly resolve the broader torso faceting or establish appearance acceptance.

The garment remains almost entirely white with a narrow lavender diagonal band and sparse edge piping. Lamé material response is not visible in these current renders, and the intended fencing-practice identity is still weak.

Crouch/sit retain skirt and shorts overlap and abrupt hem deformation; prone remains a broad disk-like flare. Avatar fit, final skin weights, Shape Key response, validated UVs, Unity/VRChat execution and package eligibility remain unverified.

nextAction: Trace the new V110 posterior hot-edge source vertices and adjacent face ownership through native, collar-contour, torso-contour, upper-surface and fairing stages. Identify the first stage that creates the remaining local discontinuity before making another bounded correction. Keep REJECT and downstream fit/runtime/release gates closed.
